GRAMMAR The future in the past
There are several ways of referring to future plans,
promises or predictions that we made in the past.
Usually, am going to becomes was going to and will
becomes would.
I was going to stay in, but a friend called me and
so l ended up going out to see a play.
The film was much better than I thought it would be.
